draftContext.markdown: Gate before first live correspondence window: (1) core #619 must exit draft and reach review-ready; (2) CG307-U1 native admission review must complete for both core #618 and BookcaseDiscovery #103; (3) owner explicit per-machine setup on each Mac. Yuri prerequisite: main checkout must carry the core #609 repo-sync loop script before installation — that script changes scheduled jobs and requires explicit owner yes per machine; not yet installed on either Mac. Core #609 is not confirmed on the critical path to correspondence activation, but its uninstalled state is a gap in the committed → installed lifecycle. Core #615 (built-in drift registry) is open and outside the correspondence charter; the fourth plugin observed in the afternoon 2.1.308 session on 2026-11-16 is not yet identified from committed evidence. Core #602 (stale docs cleanup, opened 2026-11-14) is non-draft with no reported blocker and no stated relationship to any open PR — disposition unknown. Core #597 and #598 are prerequisites for the Selfco worker migration and are higher-dependency than #602 despite appearing as equivalent items in the flat roadmap list. Daily-logger #549 and #548 are non-draft and address structural prompt gaps flagged across multiple independent reviews; neither has a stated blocker. The nine draft audit PRs (#533–#551) have no stated merge cadence or owner assignment; their disposition as reference artifacts vs. publishable articles is an open owner call. BookcaseDiscovery catalog v1/v2 decision: the owner needs to evaluate false-positive delta (not just match-rate recovery) before switching defaults; no decision framework is committed. Requalification frequency for built-in drift is not yet characterized from committed evidence; the 2026-11-16 observation is the first recorded instance and requalification is currently a manual process.
